scope: Real MotorLab crank, finite wheel/clutch impulses, persistent damage and manual/PCM clock boundary.
checks: A held partial clutch heats from measured slip work; reset, car switching and serialization preserve the hot worn plate.
A forced downshift exceeds the native fuel limiter and separately damages valves, pistons and the selected gear.
A stripped selected gear or broken driveshaft removes propulsion; selecting an intact gear restores that path.
Selective engine repair releases PCM ownership safely and resumes exactly one native clock without repairing coolant leaks.
The damage-off rule preserves component condition under a real downshift and collision while fuel and thermal work continue.
A swapped large engine retains its fluid volumes when an inactive garage condition is restored.
